verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI notes product, but the evidence shows no user-configurable scheduler. Recipes are reusable prompts run with a single click, not on a schedule. The nearest items are adjacent rather than the capability itself: overnight pre-meeting briefs and auto-drafted follow-up emails are built-in behaviors, HubSpot sync is triggered by folders, transcript auto-deletion is a retention setting, and Zapier is a third-party automation platform.
